title: Relationship Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
**Job Description**
HSBC GIFT IBU (International Financial Service Centre Banking Unit) is based in GIFT, Gandhinagar, Gujarat and serving more than 400+ wholesale banking clients. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wholesale Banking Client Service team as Client Service Manager.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  

* The Wholesale Client Services (WCS) team is responsible for the management and execution of client related service events through the full life-cycle of a client’s relationship with HSBC
* The Relationship Service Manager (RSM) is responsible for, but not limited to, the proactive management of services for an assigned portfolio of GIFT City branch to ensure a high quality of service is delivered at all times
* Coordinate onboarding activities on behalf of the Relationship Managers aligned to client requirements
* Act as primary point of contact for clients and internal colleagues for all services, Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and client exit. Work with various middle/back offices to ensure smooth delivery of client solutions and efficient feedback to client inquiries.
* Product & Implementation management for customer due diligence
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
* Support risk management activities in terms of handling Request for Information (RFI) related enquiries and the approval on low/ medium risk CDD periodic review cases for Relationship Managers
* Provide opinion on operational aspects with various departments (Global Liquidity and Cash Management , Global Market, Business Management, NSC, IT, Business Management, etc.)

Principal Responsibilities
  
  

* Client Service Manager – Client Services would be part of Central Client Services Team to support all service request of the client
* Work closely with relationship managers in the team and support them to complete all KYC process in a timely manner.
* Execute or support the approval of low/medium risk periodic review profile
* Manage the Client Selection and Exit Management process
* Manage the Book of work and client list for GIFT City branch
* Leading the implementation of operational plans and priorities to drive delivery of the agreed client requirements, ensuring GIFT City requirements and variations in the business model are accurately accounted for in our client on-boarding methodology.
* Ensure the provision of transactional and channel support to clients, understanding their on-boarding requirements and ensuring their timely implementation.
* Undertake all required activities as directed by line manager or as agreed in annual objectives in support of the development of the Banking business
* Liaising with key legal and compliance teams external and Internal to ensure all related master circulars/ Directions and FEMA guidelines are being adhered too.
* Raise Fixed maturity liabilities
* Ensure compliance to International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) and other regulators guidelines

Customers / Stakeholders
  
  

* Provide timely response to client queries
* Draft reports, letters, memos etc., and assist in preparation of performance reports, returns and other ad hoc requests for the Relationship Managers
* Compile internal returns / analysis in support of the team
* Support Relationship Managers in the team by undertaking ad hoc tasks assigned by them

Leadership & Teamwork
  
  

* Active collaboration with internal stakeholders to orchestrate the process, sharing knowledge and information to ensure service excellence at all times
* Demonstrate proactivity and self-initiation, working with limited oversight
* Promotes high engagement, motivation levels and adherence to Group values
* Create robust team environment where skills and knowledge is openly shared to achieve team and business goals including embedding a best place to work environment
* Support the team as a fungible resource as and when required

Operational Effectiveness & Control
  
  

* Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement and observe the Group Compliance Policy, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal/external auditors and external regulators
* Uphold the highest level of integrity and act as a role model for all HSBC values and business principles
* Demonstrate a commitment to excellence and perform to the highest standards
* Protect sensitive customer and bank information by ensuring documents, computers, files, and all confidential matters are appropriately handled as set forth by policy. Be vigilant in driving staff behaviour in an aligned fashion, holding them accountable for any violation of policy.
* Act as an escalation point regarding service issues and assist to identify and progress service improvement and sales opportunities

**Requirements**

* Solid understanding of Banking operations and its products / services, general knowledge of trade, treasury, and payment and cash management products and activities
* Relevant work experience supporting Relationship Managers or Sales teams in a financial institution (bank or non-bank)
* Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements
* Excellent client servicing skills (minimum 2 years of service in a client facing role)
* Results focused and an ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-moving environment
* Ability to work independently but also as a team player, with highly developed interpersonal skills
* Ability to prioritize competing demands
* Ability to understand and consolidate diverse and complex business information and identify and mitigate risk issues
* Be change oriented and explore ways of enhanced working and have a forward-thinking mind-set, in line with the Group’s values and strategy
* Excellent analysis and problem solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Fluent verbal and written English, Minimum Graduation or as required for the role, whichever is higher

**Note**
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

At Advantmed, we are committed to delivering operational excellence while creating a collaborative and high-performance work environment. We are looking for a proactive and people-focused

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer experience, process optimization, and cost efficiency.
* Support internal and external audits as required.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

  **Call Center, Contact Center, BPO, Customer Support, or Operations environment**

* Proven experience leading and managing teams.
* Strong understanding of KPI, SLA, productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Experience handling employee performance management and coaching.

**Key Competencies**

* Team Leadership & People Management
* Coaching & Mentoring
* Performance Management
* Workforce & Resource Planning
* KPI & SLA Management
* Conflict Resolution
* Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
* Decision-Making & Problem Solving
* Quality & Compliance Management
* Customer Service Operations
* Continuous Improvement Methodologies
* Communication & Collaboration
* Adaptability & Resilience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Candidates
  **should not be pursuing full-time education**
  .
* Prior experience managing teams within a call center or contact center environment is highly preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will drive:

* High team productivity and operational efficiency
* Consistent SLA and KPI achievement
* Strong quality and compliance performance
* Improved employee engagement and retention
* Enhanced customer satisfaction outcomes
* Successful coaching and development of team members
* Continuous process improvement and operational excellence

**Why Join Advantmed?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence high-impact operations.
* Collaborative and people-centric work culture.
* Exposure to global business operations.
* Career growth opportunities within a rapidly growing organization.
* Be part of a team that values accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Ready to lead, inspire, and make an impact? Join Advantmed as our next Team Lead - Contact Center/Operations and help drive operational excellence every day.**

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.

 Vidya Wires is one of India’s largest manufacturers and exporters of enameled copper wire, with over 40 years of industry experience. Based in Gujarat, the company produces a wide range of copper products, including wires, wire strips, paper\-covered strips and wires, and copper tapes. Vidya Wires focuses on building long\-term relationships by consistently delivering superior quality products and welcoming client feedback to drive continuous improvement. The company operates with strong ethical standards, earning a trusted reputation in the copper wire sector. Its strength lies in a skilled and experienced workforce committed to meeting challenges while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Customer Success Manager (CSM) role based in Nadiad. The CSM will manage and nurture client relationships, ensuring that customers receive high\-quality service and support throughout their engagement with Vidya Wires. Daily responsibilities include understanding client requirements, coordinating with production and logistics teams, monitoring order status, and proactively addressing issues related to quality, delivery, and documentation. The role involves conducting regular check\-ins with clients, gathering feedback, and translating it into actionable improvements for internal teams. The CSM will also prepare reports, maintain accurate records, support onboarding of new clients, and contribute to process optimization that enhances customer satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship and account management skills, including the ability to build trust, handle client queries, and manage expectations.
* Communication and interpersonal skills for clear verbal and written interactions with clients and internal teams.
* Organizational and time\-management skills to oversee multiple accounts, follow up on deliveries, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills to understand client issues, identify root causes, and collaborate on effective solutions.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing operations and supply chain processes; experience in industrial or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Proficiency in common office software (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, email) and ability to work with CRM or ERP tools.
* Relevant educational background in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience in customer success or sales support will also be considered.
* Ability to work on\-site in Nadiad, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and maintain a client\-focused, ethical approach.
